video_title: Richard Jefferson Wants NBA Games Back on Thanksgiving

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson argues the NFL disrespects the NBA by scheduling Christmas games
quotes.excerpt: the NFL disrespected us and started trying to have games on Christmas Day. They trying to take our audience
quotes.quote: Yes, they should. Why? Because the NFL disrespected us and started trying to have games on Christmas Day. They trying to take our audience, they trying to mess with us. Christmas Day belongs to us, but if y'all want to play that game, then let's just start playing hoop games, right?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins believes the Chicago Bears are a Super Bowl contender
quotes.excerpt: The Chicago Bears go win the Super Bowl this year. They got everything and more.
quotes.quote: I watched Caleb Williams, huge fan of his since USC. One of my great friends is a Chicago Bears fan, he's like, why you just don't come on over? I said, you know what, I actually love the coach Ben Johnson, and so I'm watching, I'm saying, okay, cool. The Chicago Bears go win the Super Bowl this year. They got everything and more. They got the quarterback you need, they got the running game, and that front four defensively. When they added Simmons and now you got Sweat on the opposite side that's able to go one-on-one on that front line, it helps the secondary because our secondary hasn't been great.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson identifies Jrue Holiday as the glue for any team
quotes.excerpt: Jrue Holiday. Holds the whole plate together, no matter where you put him, he's going to fit in and excel.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say Jrue Holiday. Holds the whole plate together, no matter where you put him, he's going to fit in and excel.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises Jalen Brunson as the Eastern Conference's best player
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson has been the best player in the Eastern Conference consistently over the last three years.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson has been the best player in the Eastern Conference consistently over the last three years. Finals MVP, champion, like there's not one guy that he hasn't taken down, including Wembanyama. And I feel like right now, because he got off to a slow start, but now he's back balling, he's one guy that you could always depend on. When you turn on your TV, he may start off five for 15, but when you get in that fourth quarter, he'll have 10 to 15.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains why Draymond Green is a versatile defensive anchor
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green from the space of when he is defending, he's the most versatile defender.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say Draymond Green from the space of when he is defending, he's the most versatile defender, and he gives you the ability, shoot, he stopped Jason Tatum on the last play of the game. You know he going to be flexing, that's our guy.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye names Scottie Barnes as a unique defensive player
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say Scottie Barnes. Cause he ain't for everybody. Some people love him, some people don't understand him.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say Scottie Barnes. Cause he ain't for everybody. Some people love him, some people don't understand him. But if you watch him play, you're like, holy shit, are you guarding this dude full court? Like he's guarding six-two guards and he's six-nine, then he'll go guard a center and then he'll go run off 15 in a quarter for you.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins calls Amen Thompson the most athletic perimeter player
quotes.excerpt: Amen Thompson, the most athletic perimeter player in the game, two-way player.
quotes.quote: I'm actually going to go Amen Thompson on this. The most athletic perimeter player in the game, two-way player. I've never seen somebody meet Wembanyama at the rim and block his shot to save the game. The fact that Wembanyama caught the ball in the post and he blocked that shit off the vert, it actually lit a fuel in Wembanyama's ass.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises Giannis Antetokounmpo's consistent production
quotes.excerpt: Giannis is the road. He go give you everything you need on a night-to-night basis.
quotes.quote: I'm going to go Giannis. Giannis is the road. He go give you everything you need on a night-to-night basis. 28 points, 13 rebounds, five assists.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson argues that NBA games should return to Thanksgiving
quotes.excerpt: The answer is 100% yes, they should bring back Thanksgiving games.
quotes.quote: The answer is 100% yes, they should bring back Thanksgiving games. First of all, the fact that the NFL, I listen, I know all of us, none of us, all of us work, so it would impact us, but let's just play the hype. Yes, they should. Why? Because the NFL disrespected us and started trying to have games on Christmas Day. They trying to take our audience, they trying to mess with us. Christmas Day belongs to us, but if y'all want to play that game, then let's just start playing hoop games, right? So now all of a sudden when you watching the whoever versus whoever and the score is 42-7, now you can switch the channel and turn on a basketball game.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins credits Nico Harrison for the Dallas Mavericks' success
quotes.excerpt: I would say the Dallas Mavericks, criticized for probably having the worst trade in NBA history trading Luka.
quotes.quote: I would say the Dallas Mavericks, criticized for probably having the worst trade in NBA history trading Luka. You luck up and you get a gem in Dereck Lively II. You need to be thankful for Nico Harrison every single day he walks into that building, that practice facility, that organization.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson praises the Miami Heat's recent performance
quotes.excerpt: I think the Miami Heat, Clay Thompson off to a start, Davion Mitchell turning into one of the best point guards.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say the Miami Heat. I think the Miami Heat, Clay Thompson off to a start, Davion Mitchell turning into one of the best point guards in the league with the way he's performed, and then Giannis rounding into form, Bam finding his groove. If you look at it, they should be thankful that Giannis is in that building, that the pieces around Giannis are starting to figure it out. So if we talking about what their record was in October versus what their record is in November, they should be very, very thankful for their record in November.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins expresses concern over the New Orleans Pelicans' direction
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go with the Pelicans, and not just the players in the gym, but the whole organization.
quotes.quote: I'm going to go with the Pelicans, and not just the players in the gym, but the whole organization needs to go in the gym and figure out which direction they want to go. They're the only team that's all over the place. I love Joe Dumars, I love Troy Weaver, those are my guys, but you need to figure out that whole situation. It seems like it's a mess. There's a lot of confusion. Dejounte Murray, he wants out, obviously it's going to be hard to trade him. You want a lot back for Trey Murphy. Okay, is you going to turn over the keys to Derek Queen or you going to continue to wait to see if Zion is going to take an All-NBA leap?
